results.sql: SELECT admin2_pcode, admin2_name, admin1_name, pct_le30, pop_total FROM v_indicators_adm2 WHERE country_iso = 'COL' AND education_level = 'secalta' AND mode = 'walking' AND pop_total > 0 ORDER BY pct_le30 ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT admin1_name, ROUND(AVG(pct_le30),1) AS avg_pct_le30, COUNT(DISTINCT admin2_pcode) AS n_districts FROM v_indicators_adm2 WHERE country_iso = 'COL' AND education_level = 'secalta' AND mode = 'walking' AND pop_total > 0 GROUP BY admin1_name ORDER BY avg_pct_le30 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT ROUND(SUM(pop_total * (1 - pct_le30 / 100))) AS children_underserved FROM v_indicators_adm2 WHERE country_iso = 'COL' AND education_level = 'secalta' AND mode = 'walking' AND pop_total > 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(pct_le15 * pop_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pop_total),0),1) AS pct_le15, ROUND(SUM(pct_le30 * pop_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pop_total),0),1) AS pct_le30, ROUND(SUM(pct_le60 * pop_total) / NULLIF(SUM(pop_total),0),1) AS pct_le60, SUM(pop_total) AS pop_total FROM v_indicators_adm2 WHERE country_iso = 'COL' AND education_level = 'secalta' AND mode = 'walking' AND pop_total > 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT admin2_pcode, admin2_name, admin1_name, pct_le60, pop_total FROM v_indicators_adm2 WHERE country_iso = 'COL' AND education_level = 'secalta' AND mode = 'walking' AND pct_le60 < 50 AND pop_total > 0 LIMIT 50

SELECT admin2_pcode, admin2_name, admin1_name, pct_le30, pop_total FROM v_indicators_adm2 WHERE country_iso = 'COL' AND education_level = 'secalta' AND mode = 'walking' AND pop_total > 0 ORDER BY pct_le30 ASC LIMIT 10
